label: Multi-specialty
lead: You added a second doctor. Then a third. Then a dermatologist on weekends. Each one brought their own software, their own forms, their own way of billing. Lucoze undoes all of that.
why: Across cardiology, derm, OPD — the doctor reading next sees the same record. No re-asking, no re-explaining.
One invoice spans 3 doctors and 2 procedures — still GST-compliant, still itemised.
Add a new doctor in 10 minutes — her schedule, her billing rates, her referral chain are inherited from the template.
Front desk in 3 Bihar / UP clinics retrained on Lucoze in 2 hours. Without yelling.

detail.title: One record across every department
detail.body: A multi-specialty clinic's core problem is fragmentation: each doctor arrived with their own tool and their own forms. Lucoze puts every department — OPD, cardiology, dermatology and the rest — on one patient timeline, so the next doctor to see a patient reads the same record instead of re-asking. Billing spans multiple doctors and procedures on a single GST-compliant, itemised invoice.

detail.title: Grows without re-training the whole desk
detail.body: Adding a doctor is a template, not a project: her schedule, billing rates and referral chain are inherited, so the front desk isn't re-learning the system every time the clinic expands. The interface is available in Hindi, which is what lets a Tier-2 front desk pick it up in an afternoon rather than over weeks.

faqs.q: Can one invoice cover several doctors and procedures?
faqs.a: Yes — a single itemised, GST-compliant invoice can span multiple doctors and procedures from the same visit, with each line mapped to the right doctor.

faqs.q: How hard is it to add a new doctor or department?
faqs.a: Adding a doctor is template-driven — schedule, billing rates and referral chain are inherited — so it takes minutes and doesn't require re-training the front desk.

faqs.q: Is a Hindi interface available for front-desk staff?
faqs.a: Yes. The front-desk interface is available in Hindi, which is what lets Tier-2 clinic staff get productive quickly. Bengali and Odia are on the roadmap.
